mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for the teaching of health education as a subject in schools."
Health education teachers are responsible for the teaching of health education as a subject in schools.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a violation of any child right."
Child abuse refers to a violation of any child right.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those procedures that seek to prevent the health status of an individual from negative fluctuation e.g. immunisation, vaccination etc."
Health protection/prevention are those procedures that seek to prevent the health status of an individual from negative fluctuation e.g. immunisation, vaccination etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the brand name for a set of tiny, silicon rubber tubes, each containing a Manufactured form of a single hormone called progesterone."
Norplant is the brand name for a set of tiny, silicon rubber tubes, each containing a Manufactured form of a single hormone called progesterone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a screening test of a child's healthy growth and development."
Anthropometric measurement is a screening test of a child's healthy growth and development.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the period for imitation of teachers, parents, heroes, film actors/actresses, sports stars and other adults who are regarded by children as models."
The early childhood period is the period for imitation of teachers, parents, heroes, film actors/actresses, sports stars and other adults who are regarded by children as models.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the act of wanting to know."
Curiosity refers to the act of wanting to know.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with the treatment of the disorder of and injuries to the nervous system."
Neurologists are concerned with the treatment of the disorder of and injuries to the nervous system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the highest organisation that coordinates health programmes all over the world."
The World Health Organisation (WHO) is the highest organisation that coordinates health programmes all over the world.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with the practice of caring for or treating injuries and illnesses that occur in the young physically active children and adolescents."
Pediatrists are concerned with the practice of caring for or treating injuries and illnesses that occur in the young physically active children and adolescents.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for diagnosis, treatment and prevention of mental illness."
Psychiatrists are responsible for diagnosis, treatment and prevention of mental illness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to situation in which a child is born already dead which might have occurred few days or weeks in the uterus before birth."
Still-birth refers to situation in which a child is born already dead which might have occurred few days or weeks in the uterus before birth.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the procedure taken by schools to prevent pupils from being affected by certain health problems e.g. polio, measles, tetanus, small pox, chicken pox, etc."
Immunisation is the procedure taken by schools to prevent pupils from being affected by certain health problems e.g. polio, measles, tetanus, small pox, chicken pox, etc.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the procedures that are carried out by doctors, nurses, counselors, teachers or other qualified personnel in order to interpret to pupils and parents the nature and significance of health problems."

Health counselling is the procedures that are carried out by doctors, nurses, counselors, teachers or other qualified personnel in order to interpret to pupils and parents the nature and significance of health problems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most frequently abused despite conventions and laws promulgated against child abuse Yakubu, Moronkola and Sokoya(2007)."
Children are the most frequently abused despite conventions and laws promulgated against child abuse Yakubu, Moronkola and Sokoya(2007).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those procedures that measure pupils' motor skills, muscle strength, muscle and heart endurance, joints flexibility, agility, power, and other health and performance - related factors."

Physical fitness tests are those procedures that measure pupils' motor skills, muscle strength, muscle and heart endurance, joints flexibility, agility, power, and other health and performance - related factors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the devices used for preventing pregnancy."
The contraceptives are the devices used for preventing pregnancy.

right

Orthopedists are responsible for treating injuries and disorders of the musculoskeletal systems.
